title: AION 2 Server Transfer: Date and Global Rules
description: Prepare for AION 2 Global server transfers: October 14 planned start, initial free transfers, same-faction rules and Advanced Access limits.
summary: Global server transfers are planned from October 14, initially free and within the same faction. Advanced Access characters initially stay within the Advanced Access server pool.
quickAnswer: Global transfers are planned to open October 14, 2026, initially free and within the same faction. Advanced Access characters may initially move only between Advanced Access servers.
